blocks.tamil_translation: ”, Hazrat Jabir ibn Abdullah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- After a long journey, returning home at night without prior notice is not appropriate. (Because) without prior notice, the family would not have made arrangements beforehand to welcome him. But if the news of his return was known to them beforehand, there is nothing wrong in returning home at night — this is understood from this hadith.
(Nawawi)
